object Refusal {
  def f(a: Int): Unit = if (a < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException(s"negative $a")
  def g(a: Int): Int = if (a < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("negative") else a
  def h(a: Int): Unit =
    if (a > 9)
      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
        "too big")
  def i(a: Option[Int]): Int = a.getOrElse(throw new IllegalStateException("none"))
  def j(a: Int): Int = a match {
    case 0 => throw new IllegalArgumentException("zero")
    case n => n
  }
  def k(a: Int): Unit = if (a == 5) throw overflow(a)
}
